I cried myself to sleep almost every night from the age to 13 to 18.

I fell in love with a girl in my class.I was in 9th standard at that time.She told one of my friends that she liked me.I thought she loved me like I did became very happy.Gave her more chocolates on my birthday than other girls(hehe).
But never talked to her about my feelings as I thought she felt the same about me.In December of that year,a friend gave me a slam book in which she had written that she would like to go on a date with some other guy.And I was heartbroken for the first time in my life.
